full_judgment:
7. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record submits that the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed have caused miscarriage of justice inasmuch as the conviction has been solely based on the confessional statements which were not true and voluntary as they were not only retracted but they were also extracted under duress and coercion. It is also urged that the judgment of conviction is a product of non-appreciation and misreading of evidence. 

 8. We have heard Mr. Nawab Ali and perused the impugned judgment and other connected papers. We regret, we do not find any merit in the points urged and the High Court Division upon correct assessment of the evidence and materials on record arrived at a correct decision and rightly dismissed the appeal. There is therefore no cogent reason to interfere with the same.
